description: Sample a regular grid of terrain elevations across a bounding box and report the highest and lowest sampled points, the mean elevation, and the relief, plus the full elevation matrix with each cell's dataset. Values are point samples at grid nodes (box edges included), not cell averages, so a summit between nodes is missed; to refine a candidate high or low point, call again with a smaller box around it. Over open water, Mapzen cells are sea-floor depths. Rows times columns may not exceed 250.

cols.description: Grid columns, west to east, edges included (2–25, default 10). rows × cols must be at most 250.

north.description: Northern edge latitude, decimal degrees. Must be greater than south.

rows.description: Grid rows, north to south, edges included (2–25, default 10). rows × cols must be at most 250.

source.description: Elevation source: auto (default) uses USGS 3DEP where it has data and Open Topo Data (SRTM, with Mapzen terrain tiles where SRTM has no data) for the rest; usgs_3dep uses 3DEP only; opentopodata uses Open Topo Data only. Case is ignored and spaces or hyphens read as underscores, so USGS-3DEP and open topo data are accepted; 3dep, usgs, and epqs are also aliases for usgs_3dep.

west.description: Western edge longitude, decimal degrees. Must be less than east; a box crossing longitude 180 must be split into two calls.

name: elevation_get_grid

attribution.description: Sources to credit for the returned values, one line per dataset that answered.

cell_datasets.description: Provenance matrix with the same [row][col] indexing as elevations_m.

items.description: One row of nodes, west to east.
Dataset that answered this node, or null where none had data.

col_spacing_m.description: East-west distance between node columns at the box's center latitude, meters.

datasets_used.description: Number of values each dataset answered.

mapzen.description: Values answered by Mapzen terrain tiles via Open Topo Data.

srtm30m.description: Values answered by SRTM via Open Topo Data.

elevations_m.description: Elevation matrix indexed [row][col], rows north to south, columns west to east.

items.description: One row of nodes, west to east.
Elevation in meters, or null where no queried dataset had data.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_bbox`: south is not below north, or west is not below east. `too_many_cells`: rows × cols exceeds 250. `no_coverage`: No grid node returned an elevation. `usgs_unavailable`: USGS 3DEP failed: a server error, rate limit, network error, or timeout that outlasted the retries (retryable), or a client error or unexpected status that retrying cannot fix (not retryable). `opentopodata_unavailable`: Open Topo Data failed: a server error, network error, timeout, or unreadable response that outlasted the retries (retryable), or an unexpected status that retrying cannot fix (not retryable). `opentopodata_rate_limited`: Open Topo Data kept answering HTTP 429 through the retries, or asked for a wait over 8 s. `opentopodata_daily_limit`: Only on the public Open Topo Data instance: this server has sent it 1,000 requests in the trailing 24 hours, so no request was sent. `opentopodata_config_rejected`: The Open Topo Data instance answered 401, 403, or 404, a redirect from a self-hosted instance, a 400 naming a dataset it lacks or a location limit below 100, or a 200 naming a dataset this server did not request. `sampling_deadline_exceeded`: The call's 45 s sampling budget ran out (a retry deadline, or a wait in either provider's request queue), or the USGS 3DEP lookups other calls had queued, plus this call's, would not drain within the calls' budgets, so it sent none and data.retryAfter gives the seconds until the queued lookups drain. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

latitudes_deg.description: Latitude of each row, north to south; row 0 is the north edge.

longitudes_deg.description: Longitude of each column, west to east; column 0 is the west edge.

notice.description: Guidance on nodes without data, boxes spanning the USGS 3DEP coverage edge, Mapzen sea-floor values, and node spacing against the source resolution.

resolution_m_range.description: Range of source resolutions over values that report one; absent when none does (all Mapzen).

row_spacing_m.description: North-south distance between node rows, meters.

source_mode.description: The source the call used (auto unless the caller chose one).

summary.description: Statistics over the nodes with data.

highest.description: The highest node (first in row-major order on ties).

lowest.description: The lowest node (first in row-major order on ties).

mean_elevation_m.description: Arithmetic mean over nodes with data, meters.

relief_ft.description: Highest minus lowest elevation, international feet.
